evidenceContract.userBehavior: Create an Assistant conversation without a Project, generate one image, restart the Desktop application, and continue with the same durable generated output.
canonicalPath: Assistant conversation-only artifact retention without Workspace Board delivery
Pi Conversation and artifact projection restore

observables.description: Assistant binding, exact provider/model Tool result, generated-output artifact identity, absence of Workspace Board delivery and diagnostics, application restart receipt, restored transcript and terminal continuation facts from the canonical Desktop owner.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: One Entry Draft becomes an Assistant conversation, GenerateImage succeeds with a generated-output ContentLocator without Workspace Board delivery or diagnostics, and application restart restores the same conversation and artifact context before continuation.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: A Project Workspace or Board path, missing Tool/Job/artifact identity, changed Assistant or Conversation identity, empty restored history, regenerated fallback output, runtime error or non-idle continuation fails visibly. Assistant user-root file containment remains a deterministic Node-owner gate because the current Evaluation artifact checker is fixture-Workspace scoped.

steps.prompt: $image Generate one image of a single red paper kite resting on a clean white studio table. Wait for the real result and report its generated-output ContentLocator.
Do not generate another image. Confirm that the previously generated kite image remains in this Assistant conversation and cite its existing generated-output ContentLocator.
